info.title: Kiorex API
info.description: Kiorex marketplace API. Identity: Kiorex Passport (OIDC). Errors: { code, message, ...extra }. Flag OFF => 403 FEATURE_DISABLED {key, scope}.

recipientMasked.description: Masked recipient; raw recipients never leave the dev inbox

replies.description: Messages the platform sent in reaction to this inbound message

state.description: LIVE or the reason it is not (AWAITING_GATE, OFF_GLOBAL, ...)

props.description: Only these keys are accepted: specialtyCode, providerId, market, code. Values: specialty code, id, ISO market, SCREAMING_SNAKE code. Anything else is a 400.

signature.description: base64url HMAC-SHA256 over the sorted-key JSON of the snapshot without this field

flags.description: Map of Kiorex flag key -> effective state (hide entry points when enabled=false)

gate.description: Launch-gate evidence recorded by a human; null until then

nationalIdLast4.description: National ID is never returned; last 4 digits only

expiresAt.description: Age of majority: guardian access ends

bookings.description: Contributed by other modules (bookings, vault, pharmacyOrders, labBookings ...)

bookable.description: false when kiorex.marketplace is OFF: show clinicPhone instead

emergency.description: Present for emergency language: show 123 guidance, never booking

marketsLive.description: Only present (empty) when no market is live

clinic.description: Clinic: id, nameEn/Ar, addressEn/Ar, latitude, longitude, phone, amenities...

kind.description: Notification kind, e.g. BOOKING_CONFIRMED, REMINDER_24H, WAITLIST_OFFER, FOLLOW_UP_DUE, RECORD_SHARED

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted checkout URL while the payment is open

id.description: Kiorex booking id; also the Kiorly Idempotency-Key / externalReference

cancellationPolicy.description: Kiorly cancellation policy as published on the listing

ai.description: true only when a model produced the suggestion (AI badge)

fallbackReason.description: Why the rules path answered: FLAG_AWAITING_GATE, NO_AI_CONSENT, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, PROVIDER_ERROR...

status.description: APPLIED | IGNORED | UNKNOWN_BOOKING | DUPLICATE (de-duplicated on eventId); other values are event-specific outcomes

events.description: BookingEvent rows: INTENT, HOLD, KIORLY_CALL, WEBHOOK, PAYMENT, STATE, RECONCILE

lagMs.description: Age of the oldest undelivered event in ms

balances.description: Ledger balances per account (PSP_CLEARING, HELD:*, PAYABLE:*, REFUND_PAYABLE, PSP_FEES, MARKETPLACE_FEES)

partner.description: Ledger partner account owner, e.g. ph:<pharmacyId> or lab:<labId>

vatBps.description: VAT is a config line on Kiorex's own statements (FEE_STATEMENT_VAT_BPS, NEEDS_HUMAN). Never reported to any authority.

recipientMasked.description: Masked recipient; raw recipients never leave the dev inbox

readOnly.description: true when kiorex.record_vault is OFF: existing records stay readable/deletable, no uploads or new shares

qrPayload.description: Encode this string as the QR code

content.description: VISIT_SUMMARY: SOAP note as shared by the clinic (clinical content)

prescription.description: PRESCRIPTION: items are null until Kiorly shares line items (see Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md)

report.description: LAB_RESULT: signed report secure link (no raw values)

canGrant.description: false when clinic.record_share_patient_app is OFF: no NEW sharing can be granted; revoking always works

expiresAt.description: Accept before this time; afterwards the slot is offered onward

bookingId.description: Held booking created on accept; confirm it with POST /bookings/{id}/confirm

rxRequired.description: Rx-only: ordering needs a prescription from your vault

resultRecordId.description: Vault record id of the released report (GET /me/vault/{id})

bookingId.description: Your CONFIRMED booking id (kx_bk_...) with a video-capable doctor

joinOpensAt.description: Join window opens (15 min before the visit)
